nodes.description: Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH payments.
Public view that returns Token(token).balanceOf(user) when the token address holds code, otherwise 0.
Public view that returns Token(token).balanceAtEpochOf(epoch,user) when the token address holds code, otherwise 0.
Public view that returns Token(token).lockedBalanceOf(user) when the token address holds code, otherwise 0.
External view that loops over users and tokens producing a flat balance array, using ETH balance when token is address(0).
External view that loops over users and tokens producing a flat epoch balance array by calling balAtEpoch.
External view that loops over users producing a flat locked balance array by calling lockedTokenBalance.
Inline assembly extcodesize(token) executed on the caller-supplied token address inside tokenBalance.
External call Token(token).balanceOf(user) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
Inline assembly extcodesize(token) executed on the caller-supplied token address inside balAtEpoch.
External call Token(token).balanceAtEpochOf(epoch,user) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
Inline assembly extcodesize(token) executed on the caller-supplied token address inside lockedTokenBalance.
External call Token(token).lockedBalanceOf(user) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
Read of users[i].balance, the ETH balance of an arbitrary caller-supplied address, in balances.
Revert with 'no payments' executed inside the fallback to block ETH transfers.
